level_1_human_meaning.name: Reference Route A
level_1_human_meaning.human_description: A recurring internal path observed during multiple model executions.
level_1_human_meaning.utility: This route helps compare a new execution with internal paths already observed in the model.
level_1_human_meaning.landmark_explanation: Points of reference are recurring measurable internal patterns. When several appear in a consistent order, Star Command calls that order a route.
level_1_human_meaning.critical_statement: A route does not show what the model is thinking. It is a reference pattern for comparing executions.

level_2_explanation.general_property_profile: 0 strongly supported measurable properties, 9 properties with limited/mixed evidence, 3 properties not yet established -- the route's internal tensor profile is largely similar to other landmark-bearing executions, not yet shown to be distinctive to this specific ordering.
known_limitations: Not observed in every task family (6 of 12) or every seed (2 of 3 -- absent in seed 2101).
Its own generation lengths are longer than typical (median 130 decode steps) -- whether this route requires long executions to appear, or is simply easier to detect in them, is not established.
No measurable internal property has yet been shown to be uniquely distinctive to this route versus other recurring internal patterns.
